Germany’s political landscape is undergoing a historic transformation. The Alternative for Germany (AfD) has moved from the political fringes to becoming a major force in German politics, campaigning on tougher immigration policies, “remigration,” lower taxes, opposition to EU integration, and a reversal of Germany’s green-energy transition. But what would these policies actually mean for the German economy?
In this episode of The Blueprint, we examine the economics behind the AfD’s policy agenda and Germany’s growing far-right movement.
